articles.title: India, US seal interim trade pact framework
articles.summary: India and the US have announced a framework for an interim trade agreement, significantly reducing tariffs on "originating goods of India" from up to 50% to 18%. This strategic move aims to bolster bilateral trade, enhance economic cooperation, and provide greater market access for Indian products in the US, strengthening the overall economic relationship between the two nations.

articles.summary: Indian space engineers face significant pressure to deliver success after the Chandrayaan 2 lunar mission's unexpected outcome. This highlights the immense challenges and high expectations within India's ambitious space program. It underscores the nation's commitment to technological advancement, requiring resilience and continuous learning from setbacks in critical scientific endeavors.

articles.title: Army porter injured in landmine blast along LoC in Poonch
articles.summary: An army porter, Zulufqar Ahmad (24), sustained injuries in a landmine explosion near the Line of Control (LoC) in Jammu and Kashmir's Poonch district on Saturday. This incident underscores the persistent dangers personnel face along the volatile border region, including threats from unexploded ordnance and landmines. For SSB aspirants, this highlights the critical operational hazards and the importance of preparedness in such challenging environments.

articles.title: M’sia, India ties enter next level
articles.summary: India's Unified Payments Interface (UPI) system is set to enter the Malaysian market, strengthening long-standing economic ties between the two nations. This expansion, highlighted by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, will facilitate easier and faster digital transactions, boosting bilateral trade, tourism, and promoting India's indigenous payment technology on an international platform. It marks a significant step in digital cooperation.

articles.title: Army chief visits forward areas along LoC in Poonch sector; reviews preparedness
articles.summary: Army Chief Gen Upendra Dwivedi recently visited forward areas of Jammu and Kashmir's Poonch sector. He assessed the deployment posture, surveillance measures, and overall readiness of the deployed formations. This visit underscores the military's continuous focus on maintaining high operational preparedness and enhancing security along critical border regions, crucial for national defence and regional stability.

articles.title: Zetwerk invests ₹100 crore to set up defence electronics facility in Bengaluru, to employ 1,200
articles.summary: Electronics manufacturer Zetwerk has inaugurated a new ₹100 crore defence electronics manufacturing facility in Bengaluru's Devanahalli. This strategic investment aims to significantly boost India's indigenous defence production capabilities and create 1200 jobs. The facility underscores the nation's commitment to 'Make in India' for defence, enhancing self-reliance in critical military technology and strengthening national security through domestic manufacturing.
